applicant_utility.summary: This is an Iraqi-ministry-allocated place at KEPCO International Nuclear Graduate School (KINGS) in Ulsan for the 2027 master's intake in nuclear power plant engineering or energy policy and engineering, open only to the non-employee category and closing on 26 October 2026. The money behind it is the KINGS Global Scholarship, which covers full tuition, the matriculation fee and dormitory room and board for up to two years of full-time study - you still fund Korea's mandatory health insurance, flights and personal costs yourself. Getting in means two submissions: registering on the department's missions portal for the Iraqi quota and completing KINGS's English-language online application, which then goes through documents review, an online research inventory test and an in-depth interview.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Iraqi graduates who are not government employees, hold a relevant bachelor's degree with some work experience, and want a funded two-year nuclear or energy-policy master's in South Korea.
application_readiness_checklist: Treat 26 October 2026 as a hard stop: the KINGS online application only opens during the official window (15 September - 26 October 2026), so create your account and upload everything early rather than on the final day.
Start the apostille or Korean-embassy consular confirmation of your bachelor's diploma and transcripts now - an unconfirmed overseas degree stalls the documents review.
Line up two recommendation letters from a company, government or academic supervisor; referees who are not supervisors weaken the file.
Book an English test seat unless you qualify for exemption (native English country, English official-language country, or a full degree taught in English with certificates).
Write the statement of purpose and study & career plan around nuclear power plants or energy policy specifically - KINGS is a specialist school, not a general engineering programme.
Guard your grades from day one: the Global Scholarship requires at least 6 credits per semester and a GPA of B- (2.7/4.3) with no F, and the ministry repeats the B- condition.
common_rejection_risks: Arabic-language certificates attached without a notarized English translation - these are simply not accepted.
Assuming Form 4 (certificate of employment) does not apply in the non-employee category; it is one of the numbered required documents either way.
Overseas degrees submitted without apostille or consular confirmation by the local Korean embassy.
An identification photo older than three months or a snapshot photo in the application form.
Hand-written forms - every document must be typed in English.
A weak research motivation: passing the paper stage only leads to the online inventory test and the in-depth interview, which filter out generic candidates.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Mandatory Korean National Health Insurance (approximately 75,000 KRW per month for stays over six months), airfare, visa fees and personal spending are not covered; the Global Scholarship covers only tuition, the matriculation fee and room & board. The administrative assistantship (up to 20 hours per month for up to 300,000 KRW) is an optional extra earned through a selection process, not a guaranteed income.
document_audit: Forms 1-5 and the verification/consent step live inside the KINGS online application system - do not hunt for offline templates.
Every document must be typed in English; attach a notarized English translation for anything issued in Arabic.
Overseas degree: either apostille or consular confirmation by the local Korean embassy, or the PDF-plus-self-verification route offered in the application system.
The identification photo must be taken within the last three months, black and white, not a snapshot.
Two recommendation letters must be tied to a real company, government or academic supervisor.
alerts: The window closed on paper at 26 October 2026 and the KINGS application period itself opened only on 15 September 2026 - incomplete uploads by the deadline are not recoverable.

The ministry's wording allows a full OR partial scholarship depending on your qualifications and university policy, so a partial award leaves remaining fees with you; either way the GPA condition (B- / 2.7 out of 4.3) is mandatory.
Any forged, altered or badly mistranslated document nullifies admission and can be reported to the authorities of both Korea and Iraq.
The Iraqi ministry explicitly states it bears no financial obligations beyond this announcement - budget for the uncovered costs listed above.
Selection results are announced between 8 and 31 December 2026 for a March 2027 start, so keep travel documents ready in advance.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the missions portal (portal.scrd-gate.gov.iq) to enter the ministry quota, complete the KINGS English online application with all five forms plus degree, transcript and English proofs, then clear documents review, the online research inventory test and the in-depth interview before final results in late December 2026.
